{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Mega-volcanoes''' were a type of [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] that could be found on<ref name="DV GP1">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 1]]</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mirak Major]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which was fought between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DV GP1" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Clone Wars Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Confederacy triggered numerous mega-volcanoes on the planet. The ensuing event prompted the [[Evacuation of Mirak Major|evacuation]] of Mirak Major under the guidance of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]], who was able to safely rescue a total of six billion people.<ref name="DV GP1" />

Following the end of the Clone Wars<ref name="DV GP1" /> in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="VaderDate">The various ''Darth Vader'' miniseries released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] date themselves to a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to early in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY]], thus placing the ''Darth Vader'' comics, including ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] as well.</ref> [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] [[Laurita Tohm]] recalled the actions of Gentis on Mirak Major involving the mega-volcanoes as the [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]] addressed him and hundreds of other [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] as they graduated from their associated Imperial academies on<ref name="DV GP1" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DV GP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mega-volcanoes were mentioned in the [[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|first issue]] of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. The comic was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DV GP1" /> on [[May 23]], 2012.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54120/star_wars_darth_vader_and_the_ghost_prison_2012_1|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison (2012) #1}}</ref>
